Specification: This module augments a write-through cache specification with liveness conditions. According to the comments, it adds the liveness condition described for the write-through cache and uses an equivalent definition of Spec from the instanced module so that TLC can check it. The module defines fairness requirements over cache response, read, write, and memory-queue actions, including a queue condition based on queue length or the presence of a read request, and then combines these fairness conditions with the imported safety specification.
